1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the method is performed by a computing device configured to execute the method steps.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user, wherein the user is associated with the unique identifier.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the specific role of the identified user.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for a specific user profile. 

27. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and a processing unit operatively coupled to the computing device, the processing unit configured to generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier.
